title: Embeddable profile stats widget (HTML/Markdown link)
description: A shareable stats card/badge you can link or embed in a GitHub profile README, blog, or site — Wakatime-'weekly stats'-style. Likely an endpoint that renders an SVG (top languages/projects/editors + total time for a range) plus a copyable markdown/HTML snippet, extending the existing /badge/svg mechanism. Public (uuid-scoped) like badges; theme-able. IMPLEMENT AFTER mainline (test pyramid e2e + capture-groups + favorites).
design: # Implementation Plan — Embeddable profile stats widget (gaka-hsj) ## Approach Generalize the existing badge mechanism (`/badge/link/:project` + `/badge/svg/:uuid`, `internal/handler/badges.go`) into a widget system: a public, uuid-scoped SVG renderer in Go (no shields.io dependency for the new widgets — self-contained SVG, safe for GitHub camo), fed by the same stats engine the dashboard uses (`internal/handler/stats.go` → `db.GetUserActivityRollup`/`GetUserActivity` → `stats.ToStatsPayload` → `model.StatsPayload` with Projects/Languages/Editors `ResourceStats`, TotalSeconds, DailyAvg). Scope (account-wide / project / space) is baked into the uuid link at creation time (auth'd), so the public endpoint never accepts attacker-controlled scope. The front door is a Widgets side panel (approved design, below) triggered from the shared page toolbar. ## UX Design (APPROVED — preserved) Widget library side panel (discovery/surfacing UX). Each dashboard page gets a 'Widgets' button in the toolbar. Clicking it opens a RIGHT-HAND SIDE PANEL (~40% of viewport width) — a scannable list/library of the available embeddable widgets. Each list entry shows: a small live preview/thumbnail of the widget, its title, and its copyable link/embed URLs in each format (shields.io badge URL, HTML img/iframe snippet, Markdown snippet) with per-format one-click copy. Context-aware: the panel surfaces widgets relevant to the current page/scope — e.g. on a Space page it offers widgets scoped to that Space; on a project-detail page, project-scoped widgets; on Overview, the account-wide set. This panel is the FRONT DOOR for the embeddable-widget feature — the SVG/badge endpoints are the backend that produces each widget; this side panel is how a user discovers and grabs the links. Implementation sketch: slide-over from the right (shadcn/Radix Sheet, ~40vw, dismissible); list items are cards (preview + title + copy-buttons per format). The 'Widgets' trigger lives in the shared page toolbar so it appears on every page. ## Widget catalog v1 1. **Stats card** (`stats-card`, ~495x195, Wakatime weekly-stats style): total time + daily avg for the range, top 5 languages as horizontal bars with pct labels. The hero widget. 2. **Top languages** (`top-langs`): compact card, top 6 languages, bar + pct per row. 3. **Top projects** (`top-projects`): same layout, top 6 projects (omitted when scope is a single project). 4. **Total-time badge** (`badge`): flat shields-style pill rendered natively (label = scope name, message = compound duration via `stats.CompoundDuration`). Existing `/badge/svg` (shields.io proxy) stays untouched for back-compat. All draw from one `StatsPayload` computed per (user, scope, range). ## Backend **Migration** `internal/db/migrations/00014_widget_links.sql`: `widget_links(link_id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), username text refs users, scope_type text CHECK IN ('user','project','space'), scope_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(username, scope_type, scope_ref))`. One uuid per (user, scope); widget type + range + theme are query/path params on the public URL. Follows the existing `badges` table pattern (migration 00001 line 59). **DB layer** `internal/db/widgets.go`: `CreateWidgetLink(ctx, user, scopeType, scopeRef) (uuid, error)` (upsert, mirrors `CreateBadgeLink` in sessions.go:806), `GetWidgetLinkInfo(ctx, id) (user, scopeType, scopeRef, error)`, `DeleteWidgetLink` (revocation/rotation). **SVG renderer** — new package `internal/widget/`: - `render.go`: `Render(widgetKind string, payload *model.StatsPayload, opts Options) ([]byte, error)`; `Options{Theme, Title, Width}`. Pure function over StatsPayload — trivially unit-testable. - `themes.go`: hardcoded palettes. `dark` = synthwave tokens mirroring `web/src/theme/theme.css` `.dark` block + `CHART_COLORS` from `web/src/lib/config.ts` (electric cyan #05d9e8, neon magenta #ff2d95, ...); `light` mirrors `:root`. Theme param: `?theme=dark|light` (default dark, matching app default). - `templates/*.svg.tmpl` embedded via `//go:embed`. Fixed-width layout with character-budget truncation + ellipsis (no text measurement in Go). XML-escape all user-controlled names (project/language can contain `<`, `&`, `"`). No external resources, no JS, system font stack — GitHub camo-safe. **Handlers** `internal/handler/widgets.go`: - `WidgetLink` (auth via `resolveUser`): `GET /api/v1/users/current/widgets/link?scopeType=&scopeRef=` → validates scope ownership (project exists for owner; space id belongs to owner — do the ownership check HERE, since `loadSpace` loads by id only), upserts, returns `{ "widgetBaseUrl": cfg.BadgeURL + "/widget/svg/" + uuid }` (new `model.WidgetLinkResponse`). - `WidgetSvg` (public): `GET /widget/svg/:uuid/:widget?days=7&theme=dark` → resolve uuid → (user, scope); clamp `days` to [1, 366]; load hidden sets + renames (`LoadHiddenSets`/`LoadRenameSets` — REQUIRED so curation-hidden data never leaks publicly); reuse Stats handler's rollup-vs-raw path selection; build `StatsPayload` via `stats.ToStatsPayload`; render; respond `image/svg+xml` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300` (camo respects this). Server-side: reuse `h.Cache` (TTL cache, handler.go:47) keyed `widget|uuid|kind|days|theme` storing rendered bytes — add a small `cachedBlob` sibling to `cachedJSON`. **Routes** `internal/server/server.go` (register near existing badges, lines 115-117): - `e.GET("/api/v1/users/current/widgets/link", h.WidgetLink)` - `e.DELETE("/api/v1/users/current/widgets/link/:id", h.WidgetLinkDelete)` - `e.GET("/widget/svg/:uuid/:widget", h.WidgetSvg)` Public base URL reuses `Cfg.BadgeURL` (`BOOM_BADGE_URL`, config.go:95). ## Frontend - `web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx` — new shadcn Sheet built on the EXISTING `@radix-ui/react-dialog` dep (no new package; follow `ui/dialog.tsx` conventions). Right side, `w-[40vw] min-w-[420px] sm:max-w-none`. - `web/src/components/widgets/WidgetsPanel.tsx` — the Sheet body: theme + range selectors at top (affect all previews/snippets), then one `WidgetCard` per catalog entry for the current scope. - `web/src/components/widgets/WidgetCard.tsx` — live preview (`` — works because the endpoint is public), title, and three copy rows: Image URL, Markdown (`![Coding stats](url)`), HTML (``); one-click copy via `navigator.clipboard` + sonner toast (pattern: `Projects.tsx` `copyBadge`, line 167). - `web/src/components/widgets/catalog.ts` — widget metadata (kind, title, which scopes it applies to; `top-projects` hidden for project scope). - `web/src/hooks/useWidgetLink.ts` — react-query hook wrapping `api.getWidgetLink(scopeType, scopeRef)`; lazy (fetch on panel open). - `web/src/lib/api.ts` — add `getWidgetLink` next to `getBadgeLink` (line 281); add `WidgetLinkPayload` to `web/src/types/api.ts`. - Triggers: `PageToolbar` stays a generic container. Add a `WidgetsButton` (icon + "Widgets") into toolbar children of `OverviewDashboard.tsx` (covers Overview account-wide AND `SpaceView` space scope via its existing `space` prop, line 44) and `Projects.tsx` (project scope from `selected` state; only shown when a project is selected). ## Testing strategy - **Go unit (internal/widget)**: render tests — output parses as XML; contains expected names/durations; names with `<`, `&`, `"` are escaped; truncation at char budget; theme palette selection; empty payload renders "no data" card. - **Go handler (db harness pattern, cf. `internal/db/harness_test.go`, `internal/handler/curation_test.go`)**: link upsert idempotency; public render 200 + `image/svg+xml` + Cache-Control; unknown uuid → error envelope; **hidden-leak test**: hide a language via curation, assert widget SVG omits it; space-ownership test: user A cannot mint a link for user B's space; days clamped. - **FE vitest + testing-library + msw (`web/src/test/`)**: panel opens from toolbar, shows scope-appropriate catalog (Overview vs Space vs project); copy buttons write correct Markdown/HTML/URL (mock clipboard); snippets update when theme/range selectors change. - Manual: paste Markdown into a GitHub README, verify camo renders + refreshes. ## Risks & gotchas - **Privacy leak**: public endpoint MUST apply hidden sets + renames (dashboard handlers do; forgetting here exposes curated-away data). Covered by dedicated test. - **DoS surface**: public + unauthenticated + can hit raw heartbeat scans. Mitigate: clamp `days`, in-process TTL cache on rendered bytes, HTTP caching. Consider longer TTL for widget keys than the 30s stats TTL. - **GitHub camo**: strips non-HTTPS, caches aggressively, blocks external refs in SVG — renderer must be fully self-contained; iframe snippets do NOT work in GitHub READMEs (offer them anyway for blogs; note it in the panel copy). - **Text overflow in SVG**: no server-side text metrics; use char budgets + `textLength` where needed. - **Scope drift**: project renamed via curation → `scope_ref` staleness. Badges table handles this with `ON UPDATE CASCADE` FK (migration 00004); widget_links project scope should do the same (space scope refs spaces.id, stable). - **echo v5 route order**: `/widget/svg/:uuid/:widget` is new namespace, no conflicts; keep registered before SPA fallback (all API routes already are). ## Open questions for DJ 1. Retire the shields.io-proxy `/badge/svg` eventually, or keep both forever? (New native badge widget supersedes it.) 2. One uuid per (user, scope) shared across widget kinds (planned) vs per-widget uuids — per-widget allows finer revocation; is that worth it? 3. Should public widgets allow `timeLimit` override, or lock to the default 15-min gap? (Plan: lock it.) 4. "All time" range on public widgets — allow (expensive) or cap at 366 days (planned)? 5. Do we want a revocation UI in Settings (list + delete widget links) in v1, or just the DELETE endpoint? 6. Editors widget in v1 catalog, or hold at languages/projects/badge? ## Key files (reference + new) Existing (reference): `internal/handler/badges.go`, `internal/handler/stats.go`, `internal/handler/handler.go`, `internal/db/sessions.go`, `internal/model/model.go`, `internal/server/server.go`, `internal/config/config.go`, `web/src/components/toolbar/PageToolbar.tsx`, `web/src/components/OverviewDashboard.tsx`, `web/src/pages/Projects.tsx`, `web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`, `web/src/theme/theme.css`, `web/src/lib/config.ts`, `web/src/lib/api.ts`. New: `internal/db/migrations/00014_widget_links.sql`, `internal/db/widgets.go`, `internal/widget/{render.go,themes.go,templates/,render_test.go}`, `internal/handler/widgets.go`, `web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx`, `web/src/components/widgets/{WidgetsPanel.tsx,WidgetCard.tsx,catalog.ts}`, `web/src/hooks/useWidgetLink.ts`.

description: TestPSlug_InjectsOGMetaForPublicProfile fails on any local checkout because internal/shared/server/dist/index.html is an untracked, gitignored 68-byte stub containing <!--OG_META--> with no closing <!--/OG_META--> marker. injectOGMeta matches on the PAIRED markers, so injection is skipped and six assertions fail. Proven causal: writing a stub with both markers makes the test pass; restoring the stub makes it fail again. CI is unaffected (its Docker web stage runs a real yarn build). Fix: run yarn build, or give the test a self-contained fixture instead of depending on a build artifact.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./internal/shared/server/ passes on a fresh checkout without a manual yarn build.
